question: At which of these places is the thickness of the troposphere the greatest?
solution:
The correct answer is: **'__Equator__'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Thickness of the troposphere is greatest at the equator because **heat is transported to great heights by strong convectional currents.** 
 
• The troposphere is thicker at the equator as the equator is warmer.&
